text:
Joel Farabee arrived in Calgary as a scorer looking for a role, and he has found one. He has 19 points in 25 games, ten on the power play, playing more than 19 minutes a night. Last season he had 38 points in 82 games. His point rate (2.38 per 60) sits above even the top of his talent range.

That's the caution. His finishing is a little behind the chances (7 goals on 8.7 expected), but at five on five the Flames take only 48% of the expected goals with him on. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) shows his offense lives in transition: 61% of his shots come off the rush, so he's most dangerous in the first seconds after Calgary wins the puck back. He blocks shots too (27). Our numbers say he plays most like Dawson Mercer. Our range projects 47 to 67 points, which would still be his best season. The power-play role is the thing to protect.
